name: thinkmariale
description: thinkmariale's agent skills: a curated, consolidated fork of mattpocock/skills and addyosmani/agent-skills, split into installable bundles.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Always-on essentials: grilling, TDD, bug diagnosis, three-axis code review, domain modeling, handoff, and the ask router.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Idea-to-ship pipeline on GitHub Issues (or local markdown): spec, tickets, implement, triage, wayfinder, prototype, research.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Production UI: components and accessibility, real-browser testing via DevTools MCP, performance, and a Core Web Vitals audit.

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: APIs and services: interface design, security hardening, observability, deprecation and migrations.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Getting to production: git workflow and releases, CI/CD, launch checklist, and a parallel go/no-go review.

plugins.name: discipline
plugins.description: Rigor on demand: doubt-driven, source-driven and constraint-driven development, context engineering, idea refinement, simplification.

plugins.name: extras
plugins.description: Occasional tools: teach, questionnaires, wait-what, human-step wizards, git guardrails, pre-commit setup.
